question: The famous Meenakshi Temple in Madurai is known for which architectural feature?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gigantic Gopurams (gateway towers)**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• The **Meenakshi Temple**, located in **Madurai, Tamil Nadu**, is one of the most prominent examples of Dravidian architecture in India. 
• The most striking feature of the temple is its **Gigantic Gopurams (gateway towers)**, which are highly decorated and serve as entrances to the temple complex. 
• The temple has a total of **14 Gopurams**, with the tallest one reaching a height of approximately **170 feet**. These towers are adorned with intricate carvings of gods, goddesses, and mythical creatures. 
• The Gopurams are not just architectural marvels but also serve as a visual representation of the **Hindu cosmology**, showcasing the universe's layers and divine realms through their ascending tiers.
